layer_role: Highest decision authority; reserved approvals (budget, contracts over 2,000M toman, raises above 25%)
knowledge_needed_from_children: Strategic risks; unresolved key issues; decisions requested; RFP status; research gaps; consolidated financials
notes: Board of directors; receives only consolidated reporting (AR-ORG-002 s.2, AR-BRD-003)
must_hand_over: Resolutions and reserved-approval outcomes (approval, conditional approval, rejection, deferral) with their conditions
min_artefacts: approved minutes with quorum basis and dissent;resolution text with conditions and responsible executive;follow-up entry in the prior-resolution register
approvals_required: ordinary resolution by majority of eligible members present;quorum of a majority of the full Board
required_feedback: CEO reports progress on previous resolutions at the next meeting

layer_role: Cross-deputy coordination, execution accountability, decision preparation for L0
knowledge_needed_from_children: Project status; issue status and progress; cost/time impact; resource needs; pending decisions
notes: CEO office and headquarters (AR-ORG-001 layer map)
must_hand_over: Risk, commitment ceiling and requested decision; consolidated performance, receivables and budget proposals
min_artefacts: TransferPackage CSV;one-page executive summary;quarterly financial report (AR-FIN-008);decision request with technical and legal support
approvals_required: CEO sign-off;finance-member review of material financial assumptions
required_feedback: Approval or request for further evidence is recorded

layer_role: Supervise execution teams; resolve within-unit conflicts; send dependency summaries upward
knowledge_needed_from_children: Methods; test evidence status; dependencies; risks; executor capability notes; capacity needs
must_hand_over: Joint plan and cost/time impact; dependencies, risks and capacity needs
min_artefacts: TransferPackage CSV;managerial recap;joint delivery or recovery plan;cost and time impact statement

layer_role: Hold the most detailed technical, operational, personnel and issue knowledge
knowledge_needed_from_children: Full issue detail; sub-issues; executor mapping; source evidence; test notes
notes: 15 teams/units; leaf nodes of the organizational tree
must_hand_over: Dependencies, risk and capacity need; full issue detail with test evidence and executor mapping
min_artefacts: TransferPackage CSV;technical summary;test evidence with version, inputs and observed outputs;handover package (glossary, error contract, rollback guidance)
required_feedback: VP returns priorities and technical decisions

layer_role: Independent knowledge source: policies, project reports, issues, RFP records, lessons learned
knowledge_needed_from_children: Not a decision-maker; supplies citable evidence to L0-L3
required_transfer_format: Indexed KnowledgeItems (no upward summarization of its own)
notes: ArmanRayan organizational knowledge library; repository node, not an executive unit (AR-ORG-002 s.8)
must_hand_over: Indexed, citable records linked to issues; no upward summaries of its own
min_artefacts: indexed KnowledgeItem with version and owner;link from each record to its issue;earlier dated versions preserved
approvals_required: owner validation before publication of a lesson;access control for restricted items
required_feedback: Library indexes records and links them to the issue
